basics.name: Ngo Thien Sinh
basics.label: Software Architect · Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software Architect / Senior Software Engineer with experience in designing and building business-oriented software systems across different domains, including shipping and logistics, eKYC, mobile payment, web applications, and industrial monitoring. My main focus is cloud and software architecture, mainly working with Azure, Microsoft Foundry, .NET, NestJS, DDD, and Microservices, with additional experience in AWS and GCP. I have also worked on industrial HMI and monitoring systems for hydro and wind power plants, covering IEC 104, Modbus, time-series data, anomaly detection, alerting, and device control. I work closely with AI Engineers to bring AI into real-world products, covering solution architecture, infrastructure, system integration, and deployment. Projects include nurse recording summarization, medical risk prediction, rust detection, and an on-premise platform for computer vision model training. I am also interested in using AI throughout the SDLC to improve development efficiency. Depending on the problem, I can work independently as a solo engineer or build and lead a small engineering team to turn business ideas into working solutions and deliver real business value.
